title: Unused client settings schema imports fail configured Ruff checks

evidence.quote:
select = [
    "E",    # pycodestyle errors
    "W",    # pycodestyle warnings
    "F",    # Pyflakes

reasoning: The route module imports ClientSettingsRead and ClientSettingsUpdate but never references either symbol; the local SettingsUpdateRequest and ClientStatusResponse classes are used instead. Pyflakes F rules are enabled for Ruff, so this file will trip F401 and fail the declared lint command even though the route behavior itself can still run.
reproduction: With the project dev tooling installed, run `hatch run ruff check app/api/client.py --select F401`.
recommendation: Remove the unused import, or replace the local duplicated request/response models with the imported schemas if those are the intended API contract.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: Runtime route tests would not catch a lint-only release gate failure, and no linked tests were provided for this feature.
minimumFixScope: Edit app/api/client.py to remove or use the two imported schema symbols, then rerun Ruff.
